create_attn_head_selector: create an AttnHeadSelector module with num_tasks, num_layers, total_num_heads, and num_heads parameters
gumbel_sample_logits: gumbel sample attention head logits with configurable temperature for soft selection
subset_select_heads: select top-k attention heads by highest softmax values using subset selection strategy
group_select_heads: select top-k attention heads in groups using the group selection strategy
head_select_task_ids: perform head selection for given task_ids using gumbel sampling and the configured strategy
